appName: The True Honey Hive Flight Experience
displayName: The True Honey Hive Flight Experience
display_name: The True Honey Hive Flight Experience
display_long_description:
Take a VR flight to somewhere far from anywhere. Join the True Honey Co. Founder Jim,  as he helicopters bee hives into remote mānuka forests, at the very tip of the North Island of New Zealand. Hang onto your chair at home and take in the view as you join the crew on this incredible journey to produce the highest grade mānuka honey in the world.

You’ll climb aboard at the helipad, and strap into your seat as the helicopter soars high above the Pacific Ocean and over ancient forests. Touching down on a cliff-top clearing, you’re merely steps away from our precious beehives, the buzzing bees, and the apiarists at work. Educational and immersive, this is a breath-taking, one-of-a-kind encounter that gets you as close as you can to one of New Zealand’s, and nature’s, most premium export experiences. Download the app now and be amongst the first to take a trip to this special place that can only be reached by helicopter.
